ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EDITOR 

The editor rigorously pursues the submission of appropriate and informative articles.

The editor reviews all drafts for submitted articles and applies his/her best technical knowledge to critique the content and appraise its value for simplelifesaver.com's readership. 

The editor may recommend reworking or rearrangement an article for clarity, readability, and accuracy. 

When reviewing drafts on simplelifesave.com, the editor should also note any grammatical, stylistic, or typographical errors. 

All articles are Grammarly optimized for readability, grammar, structure, and plagiarism. We’re proud of all the articles we write here at simplelifesaver.com.
